source: NuGet resolves a package id in any case. On 2026-10-31, www.nuget.org/api/v2/FindPackagesById() returned the id Newtonsoft.Json for 'NEWTONSOFT.JSON' and dotnet-ef for 'DOTNET-EF', and returned nothing for 'dotnet.ef'. The registration resource api.nuget.org/v3/registration5-semver1 returned Newtonsoft.Json for the lower-case id, and Microsoft.Extensions.Logging for MICROSOFT.EXTENSIONS.LOGGING. The package content resource api.nuget.org/v3-flatcontainer serves only the lower-case id: Newtonsoft.Json returned 404 and newtonsoft.json returned 200. The rule folds the ASCII letters of a name only, and keeps a separator and every non-ASCII character as it is. The version stays raw.
